annotations.text:
The plate goes. It was a full-width tint carrying three pips and two words, and a plate says 'tap me' or 'meter' when it is neither. Finch, Headspace and Fabulous all put a plain headline row straight under the scene.

A: pips + words become an eyebrow above the headline (Headspace's greeting-over-headline). 30pt shorter than today. Nothing shares a row, so XL only stacks.

B: same, but the eyebrow keeps a plate that hugs its words. Pick if the green needs a foothold.
Grade calculator: not drawn. It left Home on 2026-09-12 (Kin Card + Calendar's export menu), so the brief's first problem is already solved and the band gets no fourth element.
